title: Resolve engineering entity by stable ID
description: Identify the unique engineering entity designated by a stable ID in a selected governed model state and return its reference. Retrieving the referenced definition is a separate behavior.
inputs: The selected governed model and state in which to resolve it.
outputs: A reference to the uniquely identified entity with the selected model state.
An explicit unresolved outcome when no unique designation can be established.
behavior: Resolve the supplied identity within the selected model state rather than using a display name as a substitute.
Return the entity reference when exactly one entity is established for that identity.
Distinguish no matching identity in an inspected scope from ambiguity or inability to inspect the selected scope.
Keep identity and selected state distinct; a stable identity alone does not designate a particular revision.

failure_behavior.condition: The requested identity is empty or the selected model state is unresolved.
failure_behavior.outcome: Identify the missing selection without inventing an identity or state.

failure_behavior.condition: No entity has the requested identity in the completely inspected selected scope.
failure_behavior.outcome: Report no matching entity for that identity and state.

failure_behavior.condition: Distinct entities share the requested identity.
failure_behavior.outcome: Report ambiguity without choosing one entity based on name or location.

failure_behavior.condition: The selected model state cannot be sufficiently inspected.
failure_behavior.outcome: Report the unavailable or incomplete resolution scope rather than a false no-match or unique-match result.

unallocated_reason: Architectural allocation is deliberately deferred until Module responsibilities are designed; this draft claims no Module ownership or implementation.

sources.basis: SR-002 requires identity-based references to designate the intended entity unambiguously within the governed model.
Apply the user-selected clarity and naming rule to this existing asset; refine its name and explanation without changing its identity, capability scope, or typed relationships.
